what_works: Hero section uses a bold primary blue background with white headline text, establishing strong visual hierarchy.
Generous white space and consistent spacing (1px to 3px) create an airy, uncluttered layout.
Yellow accent button contrasts with the blue, drawing clear attention to primary actions.
Company logos appear in uniform rounded‑corner cards, ensuring visual consistency across the grid.
Simple sans‑serif typography with clear hierarchy enhances readability and accessibility.
